div.span:
I used a JSON-based sign dictionary that maps extracted keywords to .png sign animation files stored locally, loaded via JavaScript for real-time ISL playback.
A fixed dictionary of pre-recorded ISL animations isn’t scalable or linguistically accurate, so future versions will transition to procedural avatar animation using HamNoSys/SiGML or keypoint-driven motion generation, or by using MANO.
